observed_failures_and_corrections: The original archive comparison failed when the live surrogate NPC credit was assumed native. Reading original objective 279720 established native Type=2/ObjectID=243801 and exposed the skipped powered-console interaction. The restored data and actual KillCreditGO handler now match the original slot.

The first static geometry run failed projector 114823 by over 53 vertical units. Native model bounding box rules out a harmless large-pivot explanation. The exact old row was moved to the installed native recording destination and all eight anchors then passed.

Initial fixture assertions expected the public console to restore before its next AI tick. Native cancellation/despawn and scoped console update restore it; tests now exercise this lifecycle. Scope cancellation was also made explicit for owner lookup failure after map transfer/logout.

Early fixture compiler errors involved unused previous-test SmartCredit and distance stubs; these were corrected. A cast-failure fixture initially set a shadowed Player field rather than the actual Unit overload; the corrected failure path passes. All source failures and client gaps above remain recorded after repairs.
client_checks_and_limits: No WoW client gameplay was performed, as requested. Before client verification, check both factions' offers, head loot UI/hand-in, native missing-champion discovery/conversation, console initial flags/pose/cast bars, portal/lighting, opponent level/health/landing/combat and player/pet killing blows, powered-console replacement/visibility/interaction, copied player hologram/shader/animation, all three voices/recordings, credit/reward UI, abandonment/re-entry/relog and overlapping independent players.

This work proves server handlers/data, static geometry, compilation and startup only. Actual dialogue, animation, light/portal/hologram visual playback and in-game interaction are not certified by SQL, simulated regressions or a successful Release build.

The built runtime also includes the pre-existing uncommitted new_blood.cpp changes. Their files, audit and migration remain untouched and excluded from this commit; this task does not apply or certify that migration.
